meta.name: Vampires
meta.description:
A Paris teen who's half human, half vampire grapples with her emerging powers and family turmoil as she's pursued by a secret vampire community.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: A High School Girl like Any Other
videos.overview: Born into a family of vampires, high schooler Doina begins to rebel against her mother's strict rules — and the pills she's forced to swallow each day.

videos.title: I'm a Monster
videos.overview: Doina struggles to control her new urges. Deprived of blood, Rad and Irina turn against their  siblings. Andrea makes a deal with Ladislas Nemeth.

videos.title: Your Old Life Is Gone Now
videos.overview: As Doina is drawn deeper into the Nemeths' web, Martha races to help Andrea, and Elise sheds new light on Redouane's genetic research.

videos.title: One Blood, One Rule, One Mother
videos.overview: In exchange for a favor from Csilla, Doina agrees to attend a party and meet the community's matriarch. But the night takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Everything Is Possible in This World
videos.overview: Andrea and Elise undertake a daring mission to help the family. Nacer vows to find out where Doina lives. Csilla asks Ladislas to lay a trap.

videos.title: The Alpha and the Omega
videos.overview: Doina seizes on a way to placate the community and salvage her family's future. Andrea's search for Elise yields an unsettling discovery.
